description: Sampled hypothesis-surprisal records derived from the ad-hypo-prompts dataset. Each row is one candidate scientific hypothesis that was tested against a dataset, with its annotated Bayesian-surprise score and context features.

datasets.name: ad_hypo_surprisal.csv
datasets.description: One row per candidate hypothesis evaluation, with provenance, context-size features, and a surprise score.

raw.name: normalized_id
raw.description: Unique id of the hypothesis evaluation (corpus + MCTS node id).

raw.name: sequence_group_id
raw.description: Id grouping hypotheses that share an exploration sequence/run.

raw.name: source_corpus
raw.description: Source corpus the hypothesis came from (categorical, e.g. 'asta', 'gpt5mini').

raw.name: creation_idx
raw.description: Integer order in which the record was created within its group.

raw.name: surprisal
raw.description: Bayesian-surprise score of the hypothesis result, 0 (unsurprising) to 1 (very surprising).

raw.name: prompt_char_len
raw.description: Character length of the full prompt shown to the predictor.

raw.name: candidate_char_len
raw.description: Character length of the candidate hypothesis text.

raw.name: num_previous_hypotheses
raw.description: Count of previously-tested hypotheses provided as context (0-4).
